name: Community Shaders at Home (CSAH) VR
description: Live controls for the FO4VR-native lighting, material, shadow, and image-quality stack.

groups.label: Visual suite
groups.description: The visual suite, DLAA/DLSS, Vanilla Fixes, and Native Shadows have independent master gates.

controls.label: CSAH Visual Suite
controls.help: Controls only the lighting, material, shadow, and output effects in this suite. DLAA/DLSS, Vanilla Fixes, and Native Shadows retain their own settings and continue independently.

controls.label: Linear Lighting
controls.help: Evaluates supported lighting and material colour operations in linear space.

controls.label: Preserve Native Darkness
controls.help: Keeps native light, ambient, fog, and sky producers at Fallout's darker response floor.

controls.label: Image Based Lighting
controls.help: Master gate for the shared validated environment used by Dynamic Cubemaps and Diffuse IBL.

controls.label: Dynamic Cubemaps
controls.help: Uses the shared stereo scene environment for position-aware specular reflections while retaining each material's vanilla cubemap as the confidence fallback.

controls.label: Diffuse IBL
controls.help: Adds environment-derived diffuse bounce lighting.

controls.label: Skylighting
controls.help: Uses a shared stereo world-space probe field to occlude sky diffuse and specular light beneath roofs, trees, and overhangs.

controls.label: Sky Sync / Moon Lighting
controls.help: Keeps native directional lighting and shadows aligned with the actual Sun by day and Fallout's single climate-enabled Moon by night.

controls.label: Filmic Tonemapping
controls.help: Replaces the exact native HDR blend with hue-preserving highlight compression while retaining bloom, cinematic state, fade, and engine adaptation.

controls.label: Enhanced Bloom
controls.help: Adds a stereo-isolated HDR mip-chain bloom while preserving Fallout's native bloom.

controls.label: Physical Glare
controls.help: Convolves bright HDR light with a wavelength-dependent optical point-spread function independently for each eye.

controls.label: Cloud Shadows
controls.help: Projects captured cloud cover along the directional light.

controls.label: Volumetric Lighting / Godrays
controls.help: Hot-reloads the complete stereo world-space volumetric pipeline. This is the only user-facing Godrays switch.

controls.label: Physical Materials (PBR)
controls.help: Requires Linear Lighting. Uses one energy-conserving GGX/Fresnel material response for direct light, IBL, dynamic cubemaps, wetness, and the native reflection fallback.

controls.label: Complex Metal Response
controls.help: Enables complex-material environment response when validated IBL data is available.

controls.label: Complex Parallax
controls.help: Enables parallax on assets authored for the CSAH complex-material contract.

controls.label: Wrapped Grass Lighting
controls.help: Wraps directional light around classified grass blades.

controls.label: Hair Specular
controls.help: Enables classified anisotropic hair highlights.

controls.label: Subsurface Scattering
controls.help: Enables depth-aware diffusion on classified skin and face materials.

controls.label: Basic Wetness
controls.help: Applies the manual wet-state material response to classified wettable surfaces.

controls.label: Contact Shadows
controls.help: Adds short-range screen-space directional occlusion.

controls.label: Foveated Sampling
controls.help: Reduces contact-shadow work outside the center view without changing center fidelity.

controls.label: DLAA / DLSS
controls.help: Independent Streamline image-quality master. It can remain enabled while the CSAH visual suite and Vanilla Fixes are disabled.

controls.label: Vanilla Fixes
controls.help: Independent master for the verified FO4VR renderer corrections. It does not require the CSAH visual suite or DLAA/DLSS. Restart after changing this master.

groups.label: Filmic output
groups.description: One output-stage pass shared by both eyes. Zero EV retains engine exposure; lower white point values compress highlights sooner.

controls.label: Use Native Auto Exposure
controls.help: Consumes FO4VR's shared adapted-luminance texture and weather/image-space exposure limits. Disable only for a locked-exposure comparison.

controls.label: Exposure Compensation (EV)
controls.help: Applies a photographic stop offset after the selected exposure baseline.

controls.label: Hue-Preserving Filmic Strength
controls.help: Blends from FO4VR's native per-channel curve to luminance-based highlight rolloff without changing the native curve family.

controls.label: White Point Scale
controls.help: Lower values roll highlights off earlier; 1.0 retains FO4VR's verified 5.6 white point.

groups.label: Response gamma
groups.description: Advanced response controls. Defaults match the verified FO4VR shader contracts.

groups.label: World-space shafts and volume
groups.description: World-space DFLight integration extracts shafts from local shadow contrast. Native fog remains authoritative, and unsafe output stays pass-through.

controls.label: Base Volume
controls.help: Adds broad volumetric haze. Zero preserves Fallout's native fog and is the safe default.

groups.label: HDR bloom response
groups.description: The enhanced bloom is extracted from the verified linear HDR scene before exposure and tonemapping. It is added to, not substituted for, Fallout's native bloom.

groups.label: Glare response
groups.description: Each eye receives an independent FFT convolution. Higher FFT resolution sharpens the diffraction pattern and increases fixed GPU cost.

groups.label: World-space sky visibility
groups.description: Both eyes share one rolling probe volume. Quality changes its fixed resolution and requires a restart; visibility and zenith controls apply live.

controls.label: Probe Quality
controls.help: Selects the fixed 3D probe resolution. Restart Fallout 4 VR after changing this value.

controls.label: Minimum Diffuse Visibility
controls.help: Sets the darkest allowed sky-diffuse response in fully occluded areas.

controls.label: Minimum Specular Visibility
controls.help: Sets the darkest allowed sky-specular response in fully occluded areas.

controls.label: Maximum Zenith Angle
controls.help: Narrows or widens the sky directions sampled by the occlusion field.

controls.label: Ray Budget
controls.help: Caps the continuous wavefront reach in 32-pixel blocks. Eight permits the full 256-pixel close-shadow reach.

groups.label: Physical material response
groups.description: These live switches retain Fallout's existing material transport while replacing its legacy response with a shared energy-conserving model.

controls.label: Convert Legacy Materials
controls.help: Converts Fallout's existing shininess and specular values into physical roughness and F0.

controls.label: Direct-Light GGX
controls.help: Uses a GGX microfacet lobe for Sun and directional lighting.

controls.label: GGX on Grass
controls.help: Allows the physical specular lobe on classified grass. Disabled by default so wrapped foliage lighting keeps ownership.

controls.label: Environment Fresnel
controls.help: Applies view-dependent Fresnel and roughness to static and dynamic cubemap reflections.

controls.label: Energy Conservation
controls.help: Reduces diffuse response as reflected energy and metalness increase.

controls.label: Multiscatter Compensation
controls.help: Compensates energy lost by a single-scatter GGX lobe at high roughness.

controls.label: Specular Occlusion
controls.help: Keeps environment reflection from leaking through strongly occluded material response.

groups.label: Legacy-to-physical conversion
groups.description: Defaults follow the established CSAH conversion. These controls apply live and do not rewrite material assets.

controls.label: Stable Screen-Space Reflections
controls.help: Enables FO4VR screen-space reflections with per-eye traversal, geometric reflection rays, shared world-radiance retention, and corrected cubemap fallback. Water uses separate shaders and is not changed.

controls.label: Native Screen-Space Material Pipeline
controls.help: Controls Bethesda's shared native SSS and reflection image-space pipeline. It can change SSR and Dynamic Cubemap capture; use the separate Subsurface Scattering feature for isolated skin diffusion.

controls.label: Stable Stereo Sun Occlusion
controls.help: Prevents a peripheral Sun query from forcing the shared glare visibility to fully occluded while another completed query still has valid coverage.

controls.label: GPU Performance Profiling
controls.help: Writes continuous image-neutral GPU and CPU submission timings for the selected expensive feature group. Off stops a live request; mode zero at process startup retains the existing bounded startup capture.

controls.label: Exclusive Lighting Diagnostic
controls.help: Exclusive test view. Modes 1-11 retain the directional-light ownership tests. Modes 12 and 13 expose the packed DFComposite direct-diffuse or direct-specular buffer. Modes 14 and 15 use the exact four live reflection-composite permutations to publish their already-computed native SSR or uncorrected stock-cubemap value, without fallback or material modulation. Fallout's required shared material producer graph remains active, unrelated DFComposite contracts render black, and CSAH presentation features are suppressed. Saved feature settings are preserved. This choice is also available before launch under [Diagnostics] in the INI.

groups.label: Native shadow contract
groups.description: These settings patch verified engine state during plugin startup. Changes are saved immediately and take effect on the next game launch.

controls.label: Native Shadow Fixes
controls.help: Independent from the CSAH visual suite; restart required.

controls.label: Extended Directional Cascades
controls.help: Restart required.

controls.label: Tiled Deferred Lighting
controls.help: Restart required.

controls.label: Directional Shadow Distance
controls.help: Restart required.

controls.label: Cascade Blend Distance
controls.help: Restart required.

controls.label: Orthographic Shadow Filter
controls.help: Restart required; accepted engine range is 0 through 5.
